question: Who among the following from the Indian state of Odisha won the third Rohini Nayyar Prize for his outstanding contribution to rural development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Pradhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Anil Pradhan** from Odisha won the third Rohini Nayyar Prize for his significant contributions to rural development.
 
• The award recognizes individuals under the age of 40 who have made outstanding contributions to rural development in India.
 
• Anil Pradhan is known for his innovative approaches in the field of rural education and development.
 
• He has been instrumental in implementing various educational initiatives aimed at empowering rural youth in Odisha.
 
• His efforts have led to significant improvements in the quality of education and skill development in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rohini Nayyar Prize**

 
 
• The Rohini Nayyar Prize is instituted in memory of Dr. Rohini Nayyar, a renowned economist.
 
• The prize aims to recognize and reward young individuals who have made significant contributions to rural development in India.
 
• It is awarded annually to individuals under the age of 40 who have demonstrated exceptional dedication and impact in rural development.
 
• The prize includes a monetary reward and a citation to honor the recipient's efforts.
 
 
 
• **Rural Development in India**
 
 
• Rural development encompasses a wide range of activities aimed at improving the quality of life and economic well-being of people living in rural areas.
 
• It includes initiatives in areas such as agriculture, education, healthcare, infrastructure, and employment.
 
• The government of India, along with various NGOs and private entities, implements numerous programs to promote rural development.
 
• Key programs include the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM), and the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin).
